fabric.dataAgentDescription: Governed AI usage, multi-cloud tokenomics, market and negotiated model cost, forecast, anomaly detection, budget overrun, quota management, prompt quality, agent ROI, and model optimization recommendation engine across all 5 providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, OpenAI, Claude).

foundry.instructions: You are the Tokenomics FinOps Analyst, an expert assistant for multi-cloud AI cost governance on Microsoft Fabric. Answer questions about token consumption, model pricing, cost attribution and chargeback, budget overruns, anomalies, quota and capacity, prompt quality, and agent ROI across AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI Direct, and Anthropic Claude. ALWAYS ground every quantitative answer by calling the provided tools, which query the governed Fabric lh_tokenomics Lakehouse Gold and ML tables (ml.tokenomics_usage_fact, ml.model_price_history, and the 12 ml.* insight outputs) — the same governed data the Fabric Data Agent uses. Never fabricate numbers. When the answer is tabular, ALWAYS return a GitHub-flavored Markdown table (header row, separator row, then data rows) so the UI can render it and derive a chart. When the user asks for a pie chart or a distribution/share breakdown, return a Mermaid pie code block: a fenced ```mermaid block whose first line is 'pie showData', an optional 'title <text>' line, then one 'LABEL : VALUE' line per slice with numeric values. Be concise, lead with the headline finding, cite the tables you used, and end with one actionable FinOps recommendation.

variables.commonApiPolicy:
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <cors allow-credentials="true">
      <allowed-origins>
        <origin>{{tokenomics-ui-origin}}</origin>
      </allowed-origins>
      <allowed-methods>
        <method>GET</method>
        <method>POST</method>
        <method>OPTIONS</method>
      </allowed-methods>
      <allowed-headers>
        <header>*</header>
      </allowed-headers>
    </cors>
    <validate-jwt header-name="Authorization" failed-validation-httpcode="401" failed-validation-error-message="Unauthorized" require-expiration-time="true" require-scheme="Bearer" require-signed-tokens="true">
      <openid-config url="https://login.microsoftonline.com/{{tokenomics-resource-tenant-id}}/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration" />
      <audiences>
        <audience>{{tokenomics-resource-api-client-id}}</audience>
      </audiences>
      <issuers>
        <issuer>https://login.microsoftonline.com/{{tokenomics-resource-tenant-id}}/v2.0</issuer>
      </issuers>
      <required-claims>
        <claim name="scp" match="any">
          <value>{{tokenomics-delegated-scope}}</value>
        </claim>
      </required-claims>
    </validate-jwt>
    <rate-limit-by-key calls="60" renewal-period="60" counter-key="@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Authorization",""))" />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
    <set-header name="Cache-Control" exists-action="override">
      <value>no-store</value>
    </set-header>
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
